description: This file defines the interface and class declaration for VssDatabase, a component that manages a database of VSS (Value Support System) paths, metadata, and signals, with thread safety considerations, external dependencies, and JSON-based data handling.

classes.name: VssDatabase
classes.description: A class implementing the IVssDatabase interface, managing VSS paths, metadata, and signals with support for JSON manipulation, concurrency control, and logging.

methods.name: VssDatabase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the VssDatabase with logger and subscription handler dependencies.

methods.name: ~VssDatabase
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: pathExists
methods.description: Checks if a given VSS path exists in the database.

methods.name: pathIsWritable
methods.description: Checks if a given VSS path is writable.

methods.name: pathIsReadable
methods.description: Checks if a given VSS path is readable.

methods.name: pathIsAttributable
methods.description: Checks if a given VSS path has a specific attribute.

methods.name: getDatatypeForPath
methods.description: Retrieves the data type associated with a specific VSS path.

methods.name: getLeafPaths
methods.description: Returns the list of leaf paths under a given VSS path.

methods.name: checkAndSanitizeType
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes metadata and value JSON objects.

methods.name: initJsonTree
methods.description: Initializes the JSON tree structure from a file.

methods.name: checkPathValid
methods.description: Validates the correctness of a given VSS path.

methods.name: isActor
methods.description: Determines if a JSON element represents an actor.

methods.name: isSensor
methods.description: Determines if a JSON element represents a sensor.

methods.name: isAttribute
methods.description: Determines if a JSON element represents an attribute.

methods.name: updateJsonTree
methods.description: Updates the JSON tree structure with data from another JSON object or channel.

methods.name: updateMetaData
methods.description: Updates metadata associated with a channel and path.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata JSON for a specified VSS path.

methods.name: setSignal
methods.description: Sets a signal value at a specified VSS path and attribute.

methods.name: getSignal
methods.description: Retrieves a signal value from a specified VSS path and attribute.

methods.name: applyDefaultValues
methods.description: Applies default values to a JSON tree structure.

methods.name: checkArrayType
methods.description: Checks and verifies array data types within JSON values.
